recognize_zh: CD25 免疫染色中，成束排列的紡錘形細胞呈細顆粒狀細胞質/膜陽性，分布區域與 CD117 陽性的紡錘形浸潤一致；肥大細胞異常表現 CD25 是系統性肥大細胞增生症的次要診斷標準。
features: Infiltrate of spindled cells arranged in streaming fascicles
Finely granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD25 staining in a large proportion of spindled cells
Staining intensity weaker and more granular than the companion CD117 stain
Elongated oval nuclei with fine chromatin in positive cells
Adjacent round hematopoietic cells largely negative
describe_en: CD25 immunostain shows a streaming infiltrate of spindled cells with finely granular cytoplasmic and membranous positivity in a large proportion of the cells. The nuclei are elongated and oval, and adjacent round cells are largely negative. The distribution mirrors the CD117-positive spindled infiltrate. Findings are consistent with aberrant CD25 expression by atypical mast cells, supporting systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are CD25-negative, round and scattered rather than aggregated spindled cells.
Fibroblasts and stromal cells are spindled but negative for CD25, CD117 and tryptase.
Hairy cells are CD25+ but round with bean-shaped nuclei and co-express CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E, not CD117/tryptase.
